assertions.assertion: The denial carries reason code CO-197.
The service at issue is CPT code 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope.
Syncope/near-syncope corresponds to diagnosis code R55.
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease.
Atherosclerotic heart disease corresponds to diagnosis code I25.10.
The patient has unspecified atrial fibrillation.
Unspecified atrial fibrillation corresponds to diagnosis code I48.91.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes.
Such events may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
There is a documented clinical indication note.
There is an ordering note documenting the reason for the order.
The denial was a precertification determination (precertification/prior authorization was not obtained).
The provider may request reconsideration/appeal of the determination.
The denial pertains to this specific episode of care.
